sentences.text: Revenue compounded at 12.8% a year from $4,860.4 million in FY2016 to $14,342.9 million in FY2025 [F1][F10][F198].
The path was a step change, not a smooth climb: revenue jumped 89.1% in FY2021 to $16,071.7 million, then fell 24.3% in FY2022 to $12,172.9 million [F6][F7][D241][D292].
REGEN-COV contributed 66.4pp of FY2021 growth and 36.3pp of the FY2022 decline, so the step change was a single-product effect [D582][D585].
Since FY2022 revenue has grown at a 5.6% three-year CAGR while operating income fell at 8.9% a year [D767][D769].
The mix has inverted: net product sales fell to 44.0% of revenue in FY2025 from 75.4% in FY2021, while collaboration revenue reached 51.1% [D505][D493][D521].
US EYLEA sales fell 42.4% in FY2025, subtracting 14.2pp from growth, on competitive pressure, compounded bevacizumab and the EYLEA HD transition [S43][D577][D578][P10].
Regeneron's share of Sanofi antibody profits rose 33.6% and contributed 9.3pp, driven by higher Dupixent sales [S52][D591][D592][P9].
Libtayo grew 19.3% to 10.1% of revenue and added 1.7pp, while EYLEA HD added 3.1pp [D536][D535][D537][D614].
Operating income fell 10.3% against 1.0% revenue growth in FY2025, so there was no operating leverage [F20][D441][D440].
Operating margin of 24.9% in FY2025 is the window low, 9.7pp below the 34.6% median and 30.8pp below the FY2021 high of 55.7% [F30][D749][D751][D750].
The latest 3.2pp decline came from R&D adding 4.7pp of cost, partly offset by SG&A giving back 2.0pp [D453][D465][D466].
R&D rose 14.0% to 40.8% of revenue, the highest share since FY2016, as clinical development spending grew [X34][D455][D420][P6].
SG&A fell 8.6% on lower charitable contributions to Good Days, though matching donations resume in 2026 [X47][D456][P5].
Net margin held at 31.4% because other income of $1,652.8 million offset the operating decline, helped by the IRS audit settlement [F50][X117][P2].
Operating cash flow of $4,978.9 million was 1.11x net income, and free cash flow of $4,080.5 million was 0.91x, below the 0.88x median [F80][F40][D428][F100][D429][D763].
Free cash flow margin of 28.4% sits above the 26.4% window median and in the 86th percentile of seven peers [D425][D757][D776].
Capex rose 18.9% to $898.4 million, 6.3% of revenue and 1.65x D&A, as facility expansion continued [F90][D447][D424][D430].
Receivables fell 7.6% while stock-based compensation of $993.7 million remained 20.0% of operating cash flow [X197][D462][X77][D431].
Net cash reached $16,879.9 million, 117.7% of revenue, in the 100th percentile of eight peers against a -50.7% median [D434][D435][D780][D781].
Debt is a flat $1,985.9 million against $18,865.8 million of cash and investments, and the current ratio is 4.13x [F187][D432][F180].
Buybacks of $3,438.6 million plus $370.3 million of dividends consumed 93.3% of free cash flow, and the diluted count fell 5.6% [X137][X140][D436][D437][D459].
Return on average equity fell to 14.9%, in the 25th percentile of eight peers against a 38.7% median [D439][D784][D785].
Operating margin has fallen four straight years, 30.7pp from the FY2021 peak, and FY2025 set a new window low [R1][F26][F30][D749].
The EYLEA franchise is the core problem: US EYLEA fell 42.4% in FY2025 on competitive pressure and the HD transition [S43][D577][P10].

Data quality: FY2018 and FY2019 revenue in the table is a later recast, $5,145.6 million and $6,557.6 million versus $6,710.8 million and $7,863.4 million as first reported, so growth across those years mixes presentations [R2][F3][X3][F4][X4].
R&D at 40.8% of revenue is the 100th percentile of eight peers against a 20.1% median, so margin recovery depends on that spend converting to revenue [D420][D778][D779].
Whether operating margin holds above the FY2025 low of 24.9%; a further decline would extend the four-year slide [F30][D749][R1].
Whether US EYLEA sales stabilize above FY2025's $2,747.8 million, or EYLEA HD growth above the 36.3% FY2025 rate offsets further erosion [S43][D613].
Whether R&D falls back toward the 34.6% window median from 40.8%, which would signal operating leverage returning [D420][D760].
